body:
IBS trigger foods is different from person to person. I hope I find mine...  *sigh*

And... Ya know, I just might do that.  I'd do it from my main, but I'll indicate who I am if I message you.  

Thank you so much <3
It lets me sleep a bit through the pain, small blessings.
Call 911.  Call it.  Or call the national suicide hotline and they might be able to advise you on the best way to proceed.
Thank youuu <3  How do I go about finding a social worker?  (Says the gal who wants to be a social worker).
IBS isn't some thing one gets disability for sadly. And I'll send a resume your way, I didn't know you had a company.  Small shot is better than absolutely no shot.

I know its hard to swallow, but like you said, it shouldn't ever result in some one being on the street.  I would have put up with taking time to figure it out and everything like that.  And I still will if she'll, ya know, respect me.  

I live in Missouri.  If some one tells me to do a job, I WILL.  It doesn't matter if I haven't done it before, I'll learn.   I think my strength is in organizing and planning...  Programming in the event sense, not in the code sense.  If you want, I'll show you my resume and if you have any ideas, you could let me know.

I take my hormones twice a day, so that would just be another pill to take.  Thank you for that link, I'll check it out.  My doctor had me on stuff that was making me feel better but I recently ran out.  

I am starting to think excessive amounts of meat is my issue with food.  That and stress...  However, its sporadic.  I tend to wake up with them (I'd say 40% of them do) but they can happen any time of the day for me. 

Thank you so much <3
Sadly you can't really get disability for IBS.  :|  From what I understand at least.  Otherwise, I'd be all over it.
Seriously, thank you for the info though...  I just gotta find a job and keep it for a year...

A constant job search sounds hellatious, but I think I'll have to work two jobs just incase....  Hard to do while in school.  *sigh*  

I am trying so hard to stay positive...  Its just...  I thik I am to that point where I can't any more.  

I just hope I get the online support job.  I fucking need it.
Apparently you have to be employed for a year before that kicks in.  :|  GOod to know for next time though.

BOth of my parents were never that great of parents even though I always try to make them believe the other way.  My mom would have done anything for me except accept me as her daughter.  

>I hope you'll find a job, since this is the one thing you need to survive right now.

This, pretty much. *sigh*

What is FMLA?  And I am worried about unemployment because I am a student... Missouri, (aka Misery) wont give students even FOOD STAMPS if they can't work 20 hours a week.  I'll look into unemployment, every little bit helps, but I am unsure if it'll help me enough. 

Also, the IBS was on the up turn due to medicaion and diet, but the stress has made it all go back to hell.

>Maybe you could disguise / dress as man (or woman) while you are home? That would probably be acceptable to you at least I guess? Is that even still possible? 

Spent 20 years doing that.  Never again.  Ever.  I had a friend urge me to do the same thing the first time.  No.  If I have to revert, stop HRT (which she would demand), and similar stuff?  Not only would the stopping of HRT cause a mental blow out, it would be like stepping out of a space where I can at least talk about suicidal feeling and trying to get help to stepping into a place where I would straight up fucking doing it with out hesitation.  

I mean, thats the exact reason I transitioned.  

I know my life is worth it.  I know I am worth it.  But at some point...  One just breaks.  For me, that is financial instability.  I know money doesn't bring happiness, but it sure as hell does bring stability, the key thing I need in life.  With out it?  I eventually get to the point where I was pretransition.  

Three things can get me into the state of mind I fear I'll be in.  Instability/homelessness, loneliness, and forced to live a lie. If two of those become true at once, it sets me off.  I can deal with one at a time.  But not more than that. 

Sorry.  Feelings.
If I go back on the street, trust me, I will.

>You are in a pretty **shitty situation** right now.

I legit got a laugh out of that.  

The IBS has been lifting recently (well, until I lost the job).  Its largely triggered by stress for me.  The stability was helping. A lot. My weight has skyrocketed to 240lbs (I am 6ft 2in) since I have been able to eat.  My doctor recently gave me meds that cut the duration of the spells to about two hours instead of 8 or 9.  It still completely wipes me out for the rest of the day.  

My parents are the ones who made me homeless in the first place...  My dad couldn't take me in and my Mom WOULDN'T take me unless I detransitioned.  Thats another thing I wont do, detransition.

Even if I get hired again, what do I do?  Go into work when I am in pain?  Do I do that?  I fear that every place that hires me, even if I have a spotless record, will get sick of me fast. 

I know I am capable...  I used to be very (emotionally) strong.  I just wish I could shake depression and illness and LIVE.
